title: datasources-infra write-stores plan
description: The plan of the model: one item for each store or infrastructure kind that gets a file. write-stores.mjs refuses an item whose id find-stores did not list.

id.description: The id of a find-stores entry, for example Database:postgres or Infrastructure:docker.

name.description: The name of the store by its job, for example PostgreSQL for orders. Never a value.

role.description: A Database takes primary, cache, session, search, analytics, object-storage, queue, local-development, test, or example. An Infrastructure kind takes deploy, build, local-development, test, or example.

summary.description: One plain line. Never a value.

existing.description: The path of a context file of the same kind that already describes this store.

root.description: A root path of the root-to-file map.

predicate.description: READS_FROM, WRITES_TO, or DEPENDS_ON for a Database; RUNS_ON for an Infrastructure kind.

evidence.description: A tracked source file that shows the use. When it is not given, the script uses the find-stores evidence of the id in that root.
